summary.purpose: Filename/path -> media metadata parsing (TV episodes/seasons/series, movies/video stacks + versions + 3D + stubs + extras, audio albums/multi-disc, audiobooks, books, external subtitle/lyric files). Pure string/regex logic driven by NamingOptions regex tables.
summary.portability: Almost entirely portable. No runtime machinery, no I/O, no async, no DI beyond one trivial string-lowercasing interface. All external deps are POCO/enum shapes that become tiny local Rust types.
summary.real_deps_conclusion: csproj references BOTH MediaBrowser.Common AND MediaBrowser.Model, but a `using` scan shows Common is NEVER referenced in source or tests. DEAD ref -> do NOT depend on hermit-common. Only MediaBrowser.Model shapes are actually used (plus Jellyfin.Extensions helpers and one Jellyfin.Data.Enums enum).

MediaBrowser.Common.note: DEAD csproj ProjectReference. Zero `using MediaBrowser.Common` and zero symbol references anywhere in Emby.Naming or its tests. Do NOT port against hermit-common.

symbols.port_strategy: Reproduce as a local Rust enum in hermit-naming (Trailer, ThemeVideo, ThemeSong, BehindTheScenes, DeletedScene, Interview, Scene, Sample, Short, Featurette, Clip, Unknown). Small, self-contained, no reason to pull a whole common crate.
Local struct { full_name: String, is_directory: bool }. Only these two fields are read. NOT an IFileSystem service — no filesystem access happens.

Used ONLY to enumerate culture names for language-tag stripping in external file parsing. In tests it is a Loose Moq (returns empty). Port as a trait or a simple owned Vec<String> of culture codes (default empty). Trivial; not real runtime machinery.
Local enum (Audio/Video/Subtitle/... — only the discriminants ExternalPathParser branches on are needed). Not DLNA runtime, just a tag.

Jellyfin.Extensions.note: Not a ProjectReference visible in the pasted csproj but heavily `using`d. Provides extension helpers only.
symbols_used: string/span helpers e.g. AsSpan/Contains(StringComparison) style comparisons
Jellyfin.Extensions.port_strategy: Inline as ordinary Rust std string/slice operations (case-insensitive compare, contains). No external crate needed.

symbols.port_strategy: Local Option<enum>; only used to gate multi-version merging behavior. Port the handful of variants VideoListResolver checks.

deferred_types.reason: .NET assembly attribute plumbing (Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs) — no Rust analogue

note_no_runtime_machinery: There is NO async, NO real filesystem/network I/O, NO DI container, NO threading, NO serialization framework in Emby.Naming. Resolvers named *ListResolver/StackResolver accept POCO metadata (FileSystemMetadata) rather than touching disk. The only interface (ILocalizationManager) is a pure data source. Hence deferred_types is essentially empty aside from assembly plumbing.

moq_usage.detail: new Mock<ILocalizationManager>(MockBehavior.Loose) — Loose mock returns default/empty. In Rust port supply an empty/stub localization source; no mocking framework needed.
